ticket.summary: New customer reports rotten-egg/sulfur smell near basement water heater (plus week-old slow floor drain); evacuation advised, gas utility/911 called, on-call plumber paged - address still needed.
mitigation_advice: Leave the house immediately with everyone and the dog [PB-06]
Do NOT operate light switches, phones, or appliances inside; no attempt to shut off the water heater [PB-06]
From outside, call the gas utility's emergency line or 911 [PB-06]
ticket.customer_message: Good - you're doing exactly the right thing. From outside, call the gas utility's emergency line or 911 now, and don't go back inside for anything until they clear the house. Our on-call plumber has been paged and will call you at this number; please text your street address when you can so dispatch can head your way. We'll handle the slow floor drain and the water heater once the gas side is confirmed safe.
